Title: Globex Corporation
Description:
The friendliest multinational on the planet, and soon the only one. Globex gives every employee a hammock, a monorail pass and a boss who remembers their kids' birthdays, and keeps a cobalt-thorium G doomsday device in the basement in case the United Nations does not answer its demands within 72 hours.

Globex is headquartered in Cypress Creek, a lovingly planned community where nobody asks what's inside the volcano. It hired Fourth Wall Software because, in the words of its CEO, "you can't run a global empire on spreadsheets. Well, you can, but you shouldn't."
